article.title: Certamente y provavelmente

article.chapter: Modalidad, obligación, posibilidad y evidencialidad — Modalidade, obrigação, possibilidade e evidencialidade

claims.summary: Certamente and provavelmente are adverbs that indicate the degree of commitment the speaker has with a statement.
Both adverbs can appear in different positions depending on focus and style, and they modify the way the speaker evaluates the proposition.
The difference between certamente and provavelmente is semantical and pragmatic, not a fixed mathematical scale.
